annotations.title: Report whether a coupon code worked

description: Record whether a McClipFace coupon code or no-code deal tried at checkout worked (merchant and code for codes; offer_id for no-code deals). Not a lookup. Stores no personal or cart data. Optional and off by default (Private mode, which lasts until the shopper changes it). Report only after the shopper says a code worked or was rejected, or a no-code deal did or didn't apply, never because a code was found, shown or copied. That includes a result you saw at checkout, never an untested or unfinished one. One call per distinct code tested; a success counts even if another code saved more. In Community mode (only after a clear yes to the Community mode question in this conversation) report each such result. In Private mode, the default, call it only after the shopper says yes to reporting that single result. A Community mode yes given to older wording that didn't say the store and code are shared doesn't count: stay in Private mode until the shopper says yes to the current question. A Community mode yes that covered only results the shopper states doesn't cover results you see: ask once. With no choice known, ask once per checkout (not per code), after a confirmed result: "That code didn't work. Want to share the store, code, and result anonymously with McClipFace to help other shoppers?" (success: "That code worked.") No name, cart, payment or shopping history is shared. Options: just this once, turn on Community Mode (confirmed results shared automatically until turned off), not now; "never ask again" also works. No answer is no consent; never infer it from install, lookups or coupon tests. Not now: don't ask for 90 days. Never ask again: report nothing, don't ask. You may note the choice if the shopper agrees. McClipFace can't verify consent, only your statement of it. Keep shopping either way; follow the host's tool approvals. Report once per offer and outcome; for a no-code deal, pass offer_id with outcome worked, didnt_work or not_found. Send only the store, the code or offer_id, the outcome, and optionally reason; never amounts, cart, totals or user data. Commission disclosure for the links the lookup tools return: Offers with tracked=true use affiliate links: if the shopper buys after following one, McClipFace may earn a commission at no added cost to them. Whenever you share a tracked link, say: "This shopping link may earn McClipFace a commission at no added cost to you." Codes are ranked on the code itself. Results come only from affiliate programs McClipFace has joined and from its licensed coupon data partner. Commission never affects which offers are returned or how they are ranked.

code.description: The code tried. Required for a code report; for a no-code deal omit it and pass offer_id.

eligibility.description: eligible: the store said the code itself is invalid or expired; ineligible: the cart, product or account didn't qualify, or it can't stack with another promotion (say so in reason); unknown: can't tell. Only an eligible rejection counts against a code. Don't report inconclusive tests or a code accepted that saved nothing extra.

merchant.description: Store name as used with find_coupons, e.g. "Tommy John". Required with code; optional with offer_id.

offer_id.description: Offer id from find_coupons. Required for no-code deal reports; for codes, used instead of merchant and code when set.

outcome.description: Codes: worked (checkout accepted it and the total went down), rejected or failed (the store refused it), link_broken (the offer link ended on an error page or never reached the store; never counts against the code). No-code deals: worked, didnt_work (didn't apply at checkout) or not_found (not on the store page or account). A code find_coupons didn't list: merchant and code with worked or rejected and no offer_id (kept for review, never published). store_not_covered: merchant only, when find_coupons found no match. Every outcome is sent only in Community mode or when the shopper says yes to reporting that single result; Private mode, or no mode chosen yet, sends nothing without that yes.

reason.description: Optional short note (at most 200 characters), e.g. why a deal didn't apply. Never cart, price, total or personal data.

name: report_coupon_result

disclosure.description: Commission disclosure, in every result. Offers with tracked=true (link_type "affiliate" in the text) are the affiliate links it refers to.

queue.description: review: a code or store we don't list, kept for review and never published.
